title: Crestline Fleet Account Month-End Late Charge Assessment
content:
Customer care assesses the late charge of a statement month on a Crestline Fleet Account, on the last day of that month. Only one late charge is assessed for each statement month, and none on a Crestline Fleet Public Sector account.

## When the charge may be fixed

The late charge of a statement month is not assessed until the account's most recent tire invoice posted with no fleet discount, when it is past due on the day the charge is assessed on an account invoiced without sales tax, carries a pricing correction credit memo.

Before the late charge of a statement month is fixed, the account's most recent brake invoice posted with no fleet discount, when it is past due on the day the charge is assessed on an account invoiced without sales tax, must carry its own pricing correction credit memo as well.

The late charge of a statement month is fixed only after the mobile service visit fee the business contests stands under an open dispute registered on that fee invoice.

## Booking the charge

The tool is `assess_fleet_late_charge_341e13fe`. Customer care handles it: the agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.

One call books one late charge entry, dated today, for the statement month and amount given, and raises the fleet account's outstanding balance by the same amount. Afterwards the late charge appears in the account's activity with its statement month.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_account_id` | reference number of the business's fleet account, as shown by the fleet account lookup | identifier text |
| `statement_month` | the month-end statement the charge belongs to | written YYYY-MM |
| `amount` | the late charge assessed | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded rounded to 2 decimal places |

### Return

A text rendering of a receipt with these fields: `entry_id` (reference number of the new late charge), `entry_type` (always `fleet_late_charge`), `statement_month` (YYYY-MM), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, as booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD date of the entry) and `outstanding_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the account balance after the charge). A receipt carrying `entry_id` means the late charge was booked.
